nonClaims: No runtime in this repository implements this contract. No TypeScript or Python adapter exists.
No provider integration exists. Naming OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint declares an intended boundary shape, not a working client.
This corpus is deterministic-mock evidence only. It performs no network access, requires no credential and reads no clock.
Live-provider evidence is opt-in, quarantined and separately gated. It can never substitute for this corpus.
Claude Code, Codex and generic agent-harness integrations are documented through published command-line and MCP surfaces only. No private API is claimed.
Rule identifiers are portable diagnostic facts of the contract, not a claim that any implementation emits them today.
